children.text: We cannot 'Maximize Health' if 15% of the population is invisible to the digital system. Equity requires that we treat broadband as a public utility essential for the delivery of modern healthcare.
A patient without a portal is a patient without a voice in the new value-based economy.

body.caption: Heatmap showing the overlap between low broadband speeds and high chronic disease prevalence.

summary: Analyzing the correlation between high-speed internet access and health outcomes in Vermont’s Northeast Kingdom. We argue that digital access is a fundamental clinical requirement.
title: The Broadband Gap: Solving the Digital Determinants of Health (DDoH)
